anna-sales: Acme Health wants SOC 2 + ISO artifacts for the POC, plus two nonstandard asks: (1) proof-of-deletion run against staging creds & sample logs (they want a signed SHA256 of deleted objects) and (2) detailed KMS/HSM key origin + BYOK workflow for encryption-in-transit & at-rest. They also asked for a SOC2 bridge letter covering last 3 months. Can we deliver within 5 business days? cc @priya-sec @tom-ops

priya-sec: We can provide SOC 2 artifacts and an ISO scope doc. For BYOK/HSM: we can provide key origin (AWS KMS with External Key Manager / HSM-backed CMKs), FIPS validation stamp, key rotation policy, and our HSM vendor attestation. If they want raw key material or HSM logs we need an NDA addendum.

carlos-se: Pricing heads-up: BYOK + VPC peering + extra networking for customer-managed keys = extra integration (~40 engineer hours). If they also want dedicated capacity for isolated key stores that adds a monthly delta. I'll draft a short delta estimate.

tom-ops: We can run a proof-of-deletion run for the POC bucket. Our usual pattern: generate a deletion job, capture object list before/after, produce a signed manifest and SHA256 over the deleted object list. We can timestamp + GPG-sign the manifest. Need approval from Legal for the signed statement language. Runtime ~4 hours once we have the object manifest.

legal-jane: We can sign a deletion attestation but must avoid asserting irreversibility for objects outside our control (e.g., client backups). We can provide a bridge letter for SOC2 scope date (templated). For BYOK: will need an NDA addendum to share HSM console screenshots or key metadata beyond the high-level attestation. I'll draft both templates.

tom-ops: Technical note: if Acme requests key import to our HSM (BYOK import), that path requires 3 maintenance windows for secure import and verification. That affects the 5-day target. Suggest we offer two options: (A) high-level attestation + exported KMS metadata (fast), or (B) full BYOK import (longer, needs scheduling).

anna-sales: I'll confirm with Acme which option they prefer. I'll ask them specifically if the SHA256 manifest is acceptable and whether they need the GPG signature from Redwood.

priya-sec: Also: sample logs might contain customer PII. We should require their redaction checklist or a hashed-sample approach (we can hash PII fields instead of including raw values). That avoids sharing secrets.

carlos-se: For pricing doc I have two rows: one for "attestation pack" (docs + bridge letter + signed deletion manifest) and one for "BYOK import + VPC" (engineering + provisioning). Drop ETA in ~1h.

anna-sales: Update from Acme: they confirm presigned S3 upload is ok, they want GPG-signed deletion manifest, and they prefer option A (attestation + metadata) for BYOK initially. They also asked if we can include an operations runbook for key rotation.

priya-sec: We have a key rotation runbook (internal). I'll sanitize and include an excerpt for customer consumption (no API keys, no internal hostnames).

legal-jane: Drafting: (1) deletion attestation template (includes the SHA256 over deleted object list and GPG signature statement), (2) SOC2 bridge letter template (dates + scope), (3) NDA addendum template for any deeper HSM artifacts. Will share in this thread when ready.

tom-ops: Infra ticket created: EVIDENCE-1127. Tasks: prepare presigned upload path, run object inventory, perform deletion job, generate manifest, GPG-sign, upload signed manifest to presigned path. I'll need the exact object keys from Acme (manifest CSV).

infra-bot: Created S3 path: s3://redwood-evidence/acme-proof-428765-1127, presigned tokens TTL=48h, lifecycle 14d (per Acme request), SSE=AES256 enforced.

anna-sales: Action list: (1) Anna -> send Acme manifest CSV + confirm presigned upload (2) Tom -> run deletion job + produce signed manifest (3) Priya -> sanitize rotation runbook & KMS metadata (4) Carlos -> pricing delta doc for BYOK/VPC (5) Legal -> templates for deletion attestation + SOC2 bridge + NDA addendum.

carlos-se: :white_check_mark: pricing draft uploaded to our drive; will paste link when legal ok's showing numbers in thread.

priya-sec: :white_check_mark: sanitized runbook in progress, will attach by EOD tomorrow.

legal-jane: :white_check_mark: I will drop the three templates here in ~6 hours for review.

tom-ops: :white_check_mark: once Acme provides the CSV I'll schedule the deletion job and post the GPG-signed manifest here.

anna-sales: Thanks all. If Acme changes to BYOK import option B we'll re-evaluate timelines. For now proceeding with Option A.
